assertion_analysis.failure_condition: Changing fixture BAD states or actual observations from green dispatch, inherited-only primary and mixed head fails these independent runner controls.
Product requests a base other than the actual primary commit, another head, another suite, or a partition other than all_debug; these constrain the mocked measurement request, not the real runner.
Restoring baseline-only subtraction charges both IDs and fails 192; accepting owned failures misses raises at 190; dropping inherited evidence or mutating dispatch baseline breaks 194-196.
Restoring the former verdict guard refuses before these assertions; retaining inherited IDs as added breaks clean/empty checks; dropping receipt evidence or mutating baseline breaks 210-214.
Excusing a newer primary failure that the run never merged removes INTRODUCED from the refusal or records the wrong primary identity.
Accepting an incomplete, wrong-revision, wrong-command, disagreeing-ID or summary-less receipt misses the expected SuiteDeltaError.
Dry run reports clean, plans the wrong revision/command, invokes measurement, mutates pointer, or creates record directory.
Refusing inherited-only head breaks clean checks; always remeasuring breaks singleton request count; trusting a cache whose log changed misses expected error.
Deferring an unrelated red gate misses CrewError; excusing unmerged primary IDs misses SuiteDeltaError or its independent INTRODUCED expectation; unnecessary primary measurement breaks empty list.
Selecting the stale/first merge returns a SHA different from the independently committed latest primary.
Measuring or transplanting a scoped test absent on primary returns an arm or invokes the stub instead of returning None with no measurement.
